class.name: InputMap
class.description: Manages all [InputEventAction] which can be created/modified from the project settings menu [b]Project > Project Settings > Input Map[/b] or in code with [method add_action] and [method action_add_event]. See [method Node._input]. The actions are in two layers, two [InputActions] resources that the [InputMap] references: the [constant INPUT_ACTION_LAYER_BUILTIN] layer holds Godot's built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions and the [constant INPUT_ACTION_LAYER_CUSTOM] layer holds every other action of the project or the game. The layers hold the data; the methods of this class read and write them ([method add_action] puts an action with the name of a built-in action into the built-in layer, any other into the custom layer). [method get_input_actions] returns a layer itself. The merged list of both layers (built-in actions first) is what [Input] checks events against. It is rebuilt on the next access after a layer or one of its [InputAction]s emits [signal Resource.changed], so direct edits of a layer or an action also take effect. Prefer the methods of this class or [InputMapSettingsServer] for edits: they skip duplicate events and release an action that is pressed when its events change.

method.name: action_add_event
method.description: Adds an [InputEvent] to an action. This [InputEvent] will trigger the action.

method.name: action_erase_event
method.description: Removes an [InputEvent] from an action.

method.name: action_erase_events
method.description: Removes all events from an action.

method.name: action_get_deadzone
method.description: Returns a deadzone value for the action.

method.name: action_get_events
method.description: Returns an array of [InputEvent]s associated with a given action. [b]Note:[/b] When used in the editor (e.g. a tool script or [EditorPlugin]), this method will return events for the editor action. If you want to access your project's input binds from the editor, read the [code]input/*[/code] settings from [ProjectSettings].

method.name: action_has_event
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the action has the given [InputEvent] associated with it.

method.name: action_set_deadzone
method.description: Sets a deadzone value for the action.

method.name: add_action
method.description: Adds an empty action to the [InputMap] with a configurable [param deadzone]. An [InputEvent] can then be added to this action with [method action_add_event].

method.name: erase_action
method.description: Removes an action from the [InputMap].

method.name: event_is_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given event is part of an existing action. This method ignores keyboard modifiers if the given [InputEvent] is not pressed (for proper release detection). See [method action_has_event] if you don't want this behavior. If [param exact_match] is [code]false[/code], it ignores additional input modifiers for [InputEventKey] and [InputEventMouseButton] events, and the direction for [InputEventJoypadMotion] events.

method.name: get_action_description
method.description: Returns the human-readable description of the given action.

method.name: get_actions
method.description: Returns an array of all actions in the [InputMap].

method.name: get_input_action
method.description: Returns the [InputAction] of [param action] in its layer, or [code]null[/code] if the action does not exist. It is not a copy: changing its [member InputAction.deadzone] or [member InputAction.events] changes the [InputMap].

method.name: get_input_action_layer
method.description: Returns the layer that holds [param action]. For a name that is in neither layer, returns the layer [method add_action] would put it in: [constant INPUT_ACTION_LAYER_BUILTIN] for the names of Godot's built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions, otherwise [constant INPUT_ACTION_LAYER_CUSTOM].

method.name: get_input_actions
method.description: Returns the [InputActions] resource of [param layer] itself, the same object on every call; it is not a copy. Its actions are in the order of [method get_actions]. Changes of the resource and of its actions change the [InputMap] (see the class description).

method.name: has_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [InputMap] has a registered action with the given name.

method.name: is_builtin_input_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param action] is in the built-in layer, the layer of Godot's built-in actions ([code]ui_accept[/code], [code]ui_cancel[/code], ...). A lookup in that layer: [code]false[/code] for a built-in action that was erased and for platform variants such as [code]ui_text_backspace_word.macos[/code], which are not actions of the [InputMap].

method.name: is_custom_input_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param action] is in the custom layer, the layer of the actions of the project and of the game. A lookup in that layer.

method.name: load_from_project_settings
method.description: Clears all [InputEventAction] in the [InputMap] and load it anew from [ProjectSettings].

method.name: set_input_action
method.description: Puts [param action] itself into its layer (see [method get_input_action_layer]): it replaces the action named [member InputAction.action] in its place, or is added if there is none. The [InputMap] references the resource afterwards, so later changes of [param action] change the [InputMap] too.

method.name: set_input_actions
method.description: Calls [method set_input_action] for every action of [param actions], so the layers reference those [InputAction] resources. Actions of the [InputMap] that are not in [param actions] stay unchanged.

signal.name: project_settings_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when the [ProjectSettings] [InputMap] has been loaded.

constants.constant: The layer of Godot's built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions, also when the project changed their events.
The layer of all other actions: the ones of the project and the ones a game adds at runtime.
